chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever deceives the Muslims will be resurrected with the Jews on the Day of Judgment, because they are the most deceitful of people toward the Muslims.

key_terms.أَغَشُّ: most deceitful; exceedingly fraudulent or treacherous
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims; the believing community toward whom honesty is owed
key_terms.الْيَهُودِ: the Jews, mentioned here as a comparison in resurrection due to deceit
key_terms.حُشِرَ: will be resurrected or gathered on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.غَشَّ: deceived or cheated; acted dishonestly toward others
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when people are gathered and judged

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام say about deceiving Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns deception against Muslims and portrays it as a grave moral offense with consequences in the hereafter. It emphasizes honesty and sincerity in dealings, especially within the Muslim community, and warns that betrayal aligns a person with those marked by treachery on the Day of Judgment.
